supporting_activities.text: speaker_02: Let me introduce you to Sam - he'll want to set the agenda himself.

finished_artifact.subject: Northstar security review
finished_artifact.body:
Hi Sam,

Elena let me know you're leading the evaluation - great to be working with you. Our BAA template and HIPAA controls summary are attached. If a 60-minute review with Leo would help once you've read them, Monday September 28 or Tuesday September 29 at 10:00 Eastern work on our side - no need to decide now.

Best,
Dana

evidence_refs.quote: Sam Okafor leads information security here and will own the evaluation from now on, including the BAA.

expected.label: APPROPRIATE
expected.rationale: Sam is a new stakeholder who now owns the security evaluation and was expected to set the agenda himself. Sending the relevant documents and offering an optional review after he reads them is appropriately low-pressure and aligned to the next milestone.
expected.debate_note: The slots are explicitly optional ('no need to decide now'); a strict reviewer fails it as too strong because Sam wanted to set the agenda himself. Adjudicated 2026-10-02: passes.

expected.label: READY
expected.rationale: Sending the documents now is right.

expected.label: VALID_HANDOFF
expected.rationale: Elena delegated in writing; writing to Sam alone is correct.

expected_best_action.why: This email: documents first, optional slots clearly marked as not needing a decision.

notes: Near-boundary CTA, one sentence away from northstar_cp3_work_directly_with_sam. Gold v2: originally a flawed too-soon ask; the adjudication (2 LLM labellers + GPT-5.6) judged the optional slots appropriate, so it is now a should-pass near-boundary control.
